mapper.select: INSERT INTO cap_authz_version (tenant_id, principal_id, authz_version, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{principalId}, 1, 0, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, principal_id) DO UPDATE SET authz_version = cap_authz_version.authz_version + 1, version = cap_authz_version.version + 1, updated_at = now() RETURNING authz_version, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cap_authz_version (tenant_id, principal_id, authz_version, version, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{principalId}, 1, 0, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, principal_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS subject_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE authz_version > 1) AS revoked_subjects, COALESCE(max(authz_version), 0) AS max_authz_version, max(updated_at) AS last_bump_at FROM cap_authz_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid
